name: OpenVibe.VIP

site.name: VIP
site.tagline: Memberships for creators and their software
site.what: Memberships open to anyone on OpenVibe: creators publish plans with perks, members join through the network’s billing ledger, and apps and tools check a membership with the SDK.
site.description: OpenVibe.VIP is a membership site, like Patreon, open to anyone with an OpenVibe account. A creator publishes plans with perks, and members join from their Vibes credit or another way OpenVibe.Billing offers. The perks follow them across OpenVibe: a badge in chat, members-only posts and rooms, roles and emotes. Plans are versioned, so members keep the terms they joined under. Developers sell subscriptions to their own apps and tools the same way: the app signs a person in with OpenVibe and asks VIP whether they are a member (openvibe-sdk/vip).

pillars.title: Plans and perks
pillars.text: Build each plan from perks; members see exactly what they get and keep the version they joined.

pillars.title: Perks across OpenVibe
pillars.text: Badges in chat, members-only posts and rooms, roles and emotes, wherever a site honours them.

pillars.title: For your software
pillars.text: Sell a subscription to your app or tool: sign people in with OpenVibe and check their membership with the SDK.

pillars.title: Open terms
pillars.text: Every plan version stays public, and payments, renewals and refunds run through one ledger.

site.keywords: openvibe vip, creator memberships, subscriptions, patreon alternative, members only, software subscriptions, license check

faq.question: Who can make a plan?
faq.answer: Anyone with an OpenVibe account: streamers, writers, communities and developers. Your plans are on your page at openvibe.vip/<name>.

faq.question: How do members pay?
faq.answer: From their Vibes credit or another way OpenVibe.Billing offers, renewing automatically or not, as they choose. VIP never holds money.

faq.question: Can I sell a subscription to my own software?
faq.answer: Yes. Your app signs a person in with OpenVibe, then asks VIP whether they belong to your plan (openvibe-sdk/vip, checkEntitlement), and unlocks what your plan promises.

faq.question: What happens when a plan changes?
faq.answer: A change publishes a new version. Members keep the version they joined while their membership lasts, and every version stays public in the plan’s terms history.

liveness.means: the process answers and reports its release and the outbox status from its database; it checks no dependency

drains: outbox relay, Network key refresh and metrics stopped
HTTP server closed, then the database

resumes.what: entitlement projections due for re-confirmation with Billing are refreshed
OpenVibe.Events redelivers billing.entitlement.changed, billing.subscription.canceled and billing.transaction.reversed that were pending during the stop (at least once, deduped by event_id)
unsent events in the outbox table go to OpenVibe.Events once the relay starts (at least once; Events dedupes by event_id)
OpenVibe.Events redelivers network.account.export_requested and network.account.deleted that were pending during the stop (at least once; account_data_events applies each export and deletion once)

conditions: automatic: ovhost deploy puts the previous sha back and restarts again when the ready URL does not answer 2xx within ready.timeoutSeconds after the restart (exit 3)
rollback.window: automatic only while ovhost waits for readiness after the restart (30 s in host.example.json); manual afterwards, as long as no blocker applies
blockers: idx_vip_rules_resource (one active rule per resource) was replaced by a per-creator unique index: a release from before it recreates the narrower index, which fails at boot once two creators gate the same resource

leases.none: no claims: one process owns the ov_vip PostgreSQL database; writes are transactions there

notes: Memberships (ADR-012): plans, immutable versioned plan terms, perks, product bindings, member preferences and gated-resource policy. OpenVibe.Billing holds subscriptions, charges, renewals, refunds and the canonical entitlements; VIP keeps a short-lived projection of them (valid_until, authoritative fallback, 'unknown' never authorizes). Alpha: public at openvibe.vip since 2026-10-17, after OpenVibe.Billing's cutover.
